coordinateSystem.explanation: Native KiCad 9.0.2 separates the 1.51 mm substrate from copper/mask coatings. The checked-in bare STEP also has 1.51 mm body thickness. Components use the independently reviewed 1.60 mm mounting datum via an explicit +0.005 mm correction to native GLB instance placement. No XY recentering or scaling is applied.

fidelityNotes: 111 placed component instances use the exact paths from the official KiCad 9.0.2 library, tessellated by KiCad 9.0.2. Historical upstream model hashes were not recorded; same filename is not a guarantee of identical historical geometry. Bounds comparison below makes revision changes visible.
21 excluded local/vendor references use axis-aligned boxes with the exact published reviewed bounds; these are documented package envelopes, not recovered or exact vendor models.
D3 uses its existing documented UNVERIFIED source allowance because the referenced official release path returns 404.
142 footprint placement records and 133 model transforms match current KiCad source, despite a different historical board hash in board_datums.json.

Native copper, pads, vias, silkscreen, soldermask and substrate are retained. Sub-millimetre vertical coating sidewalls are omitted while the source top/bottom surface shapes, source holes and laminate thickness remain unchanged.
All component materials retain native official model colors where available; neutral envelope and laminate finishes and PBR roughness defaults are display choices, not manufacturing specifications.
Ubuntu Mono 0.83 from the official Ubuntu asset archive was used locally to avoid font substitution; only generated board artwork is delivered.
unsupportedFeatures: Exact local/vendor component solids, connector internals, actuator topologies and pin surfaces for 21 excluded references
Internal copper layers and electrical connectivity animation
Nine footprints with no assigned 3D model, such as mounting holes and fiducials; their board/pad features remain
Physical assembly validation, component-vendor model revision equivalence, and fit/performance certification
